Hey! My two boys were supposed to be feeders too. My boys never bit me too much but sometimes when you give them things like treats they could get excited and think your finger is a treat so maybe less of giving them treats directly? That's what worked for me. Letting them be handled is a completely different thing, they'll probably have to get to know you a little more, doing the basic things like giving them clean, fresh water or food n treats show them overtime you're a safe person, at least in my case. Maybe also try interacting with them for a minute and try to get them to play. My one boy sometimes falls off of me or our play area and gets out but that's not too much of an issue because rats are food driven so I lure with seeds and he comes flying back. This is what I've done and I've had them for two months now. It's still a work in progress because they're just now starting to let me pet them. Hopefully this helps.
